Package io.github.pimak.ntfy.core

Class NtfyClient

java.lang.Object
io.github.pimak.ntfy.core.NtfyClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class NtfyClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Generic, standalone ntfy notification client — the "send an arbitrary notification" surface, independent of AlertEngine's log-alert lifecycle. Builds its own HttpClient, NtfyPublisher, and AuthMode from the supplied NtfyConfig and publishes to that config's url/topic.

Not thread-lifecycle managed the way the engine is: construct it, call notify(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) as needed, and close() it to release the underlying HTTP client. Because it implements AutoCloseable, it can be managed with a try-with-resources block for guaranteed disposal. AutoCloseable does not mandate closing, so a long-lived, container-managed instance (e.g. a Spring/Quarkus bean) may be kept open for the application's lifetime — any IDE resource-leak inspection flagging such a bean is a false positive. Publishing never throws — every outcome is reported through the returned PublishResult.
